block_layout.name: motion_token
block_layout.notes: Real, populated SONIC FSQ latent. Consumed as float by the SONIC decoder ONNX (decoder input embeds the 64-dim token directly).

block_layout.name: left_hand_joints
block_layout.expected_semantics: Unitree Dex3-1 3-finger hand joint angles (radians), joint order per g1_supplemental_info left_hand group: [index_0, index_1, middle_0, middle_1, thumb_0, thumb_1, thumb_2]

block_layout.name: right_hand_joints
block_layout.expected_semantics: Unitree Dex3-1 3-finger hand joint angles (radians), same 7-joint order for right hand

quantization.token_layout: 64 = max_num_tokens(2) temporal tokens x 32 latent dims each
quantization.empirical_grid_note: All observed token_state values are integer multiples of 1/16 (0.0625).

observed_distinct_values_per_dim.note: per-dim distinct counts are limited by short episode length, not by codebook; theoretical per-dim level count is 32 (FSQ).

quantization.storage_dtype: float32 (stored as normalized FSQ output, NOT integer codes)
quantization.downstream_guidance: latent_continuous=false: token_state is discrete-valued. For discrete modeling treat each of 64 dims as a 32-level FSQ categorical; the stored float values already lie on the FSQ grid and can be fed to the decoder as-is. If Phase D needs integer codes, derive them from vector_quantize_pytorch.FSQ(levels=32) using the exact bound/scale (confirm against sonic_release/config.yaml).
quantization.note_full_range: Full 3-task sample: token_state reaches +/-0.625 (=+/-10/16); grid step 1/16; consistent with 32-level FSQ (theoretical range ~[-1,1)). 2-task sample only reached +/-0.4375.

observation.state_source_field: observation.state.robot_q_current (36 = 7 root pose + 29 body joints); hands from observation.state.hand_state; projected_gravity derived from observation.state.imu_torso_quaternion / gravity dir
observation.note: robot_q_current axis order (named in info.json): root(x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz) then 29 joints: L-leg(6),R-leg(6),waist(yaw,roll,pitch),L-arm(7),R-arm(7). Hand joints NOT in robot_q_current; they are in hand_state (12 bottle / 2 cup) -- see hand_mapping_status.

decoder.output_semantics: 29 body-joint targets (legs 12 + waist 3 + arms 14). Hands are NOT produced by the SONIC decoder; they are commanded separately (this is why the embodiment appends left/right_hand_joints as separate action blocks).
decoder.input_composition: encoded_token(64) + proprioceptive history (10-frame body joint pos/vel, last actions, gravity dir, base angular velocity)
decoder.closed_loop_note: Decoder is a closed-loop tracking policy: token+proprio_history -> next 29-dim body action, iterated. There is no meaningful one-shot open-loop token->pose map; a token SEQUENCE must be rolled out closed-loop (MuJoCo WBC stack) to reproduce motion.

hand_mapping_detail.embodiment_expects: left_hand_joints(7) + right_hand_joints(7) = 14, being Unitree Dex3-1 3-finger hand joint angles in radians (WBC scene_43dof.xml, NUM_HAND_MOTORS=NUM_HAND_JOINTS=7 per hand).

bottle_cupnoodles_shelf.interpretation: 12-DOF hand (Inspire-style, ~6 DOF/hand). NOT a 7-DOF/hand Dex3. Right hand active (dims vary), left hand ~constant.

hand_cmd_pico.bottle: range 0..1000; per-hand layout = 5 active dims + 2 constant (500, 0); left hand ~constant, right hand active.
hand_cmd_pico.cup: range 0..1; only 1 active dim per hand (index 0 and 7), remaining 12 dims == 0.
hand_cmd_pico.verdict: hand_cmd_pico is the only 7+7-shaped hand field present in BOTH tasks, but its SCALE (0-1000 vs 0-1) and ACTIVE-DIM semantics differ across tasks, and it is not verified to be Dex3 joint angles in radians. Not a clean, task-invariant mapping.

hand_mapping_detail.clean_map: motion_token(64) -> action.token_state[0:64] ONLY. The 14 hand dims have NO clean, consistent source across the two tasks.
recommended_options_for_main: A) BODY-FIRST (lowest risk, recommended for GATE 0.5 + first SFT): train motion_token(64) only; zero/mask the 14 hand dims initially. The validated critical path (token_state roundtrip) is body-only anyway. Add hands after body path is proven.

B) hand_cmd_pico[14] as the hand block: use it as left(7)+right(7), but REQUIRE per-task normalization (bottle: /1000 -> [0,1]; cup already [0,1]) and carry a per-task active-dim mask. Treat as task-conditioned, not physically-identical joints.
C) PER-TASK hand adapters: map each task's native hand_cmd (12 Inspire / 2 gripper) into the 14-slot via documented per-task adapters + masks; loss masks unused dims.
D) SINGLE-TASK first training: restrict initial SFT to one task to avoid the heterogeneous-hand merge entirely.
hand_mapping_detail.recommendation: Option A for GATE 0.5 and the first SFT (body/token-only), with Option B as the near-term hand plan once body path is validated. Do NOT silently merge the two tasks' hands into one 14-dim head without per-task normalization + masks.
hand_mapping_detail.pass1_decision: ENDORSED BY main (2026-07-16): Pass-1 = Option A. Train motion_token(64) ONLY; zero/mask the 14 hand dims. First policy is body/latent-only and will NOT actuate grippers/hands (accepted first-result limitation). Do NOT merge the two tasks' hands into one head. Option B (hand_cmd_pico[14] with per-task normalization + per-task active-dim mask) is the documented follow-up for a later pass, not pass 1.

notes: token_state validated REAL (non-trivial variance all 64 dims every episode; on FSQ 1/16 grid). monitoring.sonic_token_valid==1 for all frames in both inspected episodes.
LATENT_INITIAL_MOTION_TOKEN (initial_poses.py) is 64-dim on the SAME 1/16 grid -> our stored token_state is in this checkpoint's latent space (corroboration).
planner_cmd is mostly constant/unused in this teleop data (control_mode==3 throughout).
Metadata patch (scripts/patch_episode_metadata.py) must be re-applied to any newly downloaded episodes; load with video_backend='pyav'.

alignment_0_5a.method: MLP probe predicting token_state[t+offset] from measured proprio state[t] (robot_q_current[7:36] joints + joint_velocity, 58-dim), within-episode (no cross-episode wrap), edge rule t+offset+horizon(40) <= episode_length, 300 Adam steps/offset, 80/20 time-based train/val split. Plus velocity cross-correlation of action vs measured state.
alignment_0_5a.rationale: bottle: val MSE increases monotonically with offset -> offset 0 clearly best. cup: curve flat/ambiguous (all offsets 1.87-2.08; weak min at 2 is ~7% and within noise on tiny data) -> default to 0 per runbook flat/ambiguous rule. token_state was computed at collection time by the same pipeline that logged state (co-logged) so offset 0 is expected. NOTE: the +1-2 frame ee_action->ee_state xcorr peak is the physical command->measured-state latency, NOT a target-labeling offset; token_state targets and proprio observations are already aligned at offset 0.

video_codec.note: Videos ARE H.264 (torchcodec's required codec). lerobot loads via video_backend='pyav' because the node lacks system ffmpeg libs and torchcodec fails to init. For the groot env: since codec is already H.264, installing ffmpeg shared libs in the groot env should let torchcodec work (no transcode needed). Reported for Phase A; not fixed here (Phase A's env).

dataset_scope.note: action.token_state exists in only 3 of 5 tasks (22 eps). fold_edge_bed/fold_pants have NO token_state column -> excluded from the latent training set. Full 5-task coverage would require running the SONIC ENCODER offline over those 2 tasks (runbook 0.5b) -- post-gate follow-up.

gate_0_5.method: Teacher-forced decode of stored token_state through the real released SONIC decoder ONNX (994->29 MLP, no norm; obs reconstructed from recorded 30Hz data; IsaacLab joint permutation applied).
evidence_for: token_state on FSQ grid, in checkpoint latent space (same grid as LATENT_INITIAL_MOTION_TOKEN); sonic_token_valid==1 all frames.
Roundtrip was executed at collection time: decoder(token)->robot_q_desired->recorded (GATE-0-sensible) video; deployment consumes tokens the same way.
Decoder consumes our token: zeroing token shifts output ~0.47-0.57 rad (arms).
Offline decode tracks primary joint (shoulder-roll) corr 0.69 (bottle) / 0.84 (cup).
gate_0_5.caveat: Full closed-loop PHYSICS roundtrip not runnable on this login node (Isaac Lab / C++ TensorRT unavailable; run_sim_loop.py runs the decoupled WBC, not SONIC). Decoder is 50Hz closed-loop; logs are 30Hz, so offline teacher-forced proxy is trend-correct but jittery (arm mean |corr| 0.32-0.41). This is an obs-reconstruction limit, NOT bad latents.
gate_0_5.recommendation: Proceed on latent path (motion_token(64) targets). Re-run definitive physics roundtrip where Isaac Lab / C++ stack is available (deferred verification).
